rules:
The collapse watch the revived token is predicted to read, and the lines drawn from it (declared in the agent
record, section 6, before any run): kappa = the median over the clusters and the live senses of the stats'
collapse watch over the cluster's reading (body 0); the predicted reading of an encoder = its body-0 cluster
reading x kappa; K2's line = the geometric mean of the dead token's largest reading since the deploy
(DEAD_WATCH_LARGEST) and the revival's lowest predicted reading over the clusters (so each side keeps the same
margin, as a ratio); A2's line = that lowest predicted reading (the token keeps the variety over time the revival
showed on every saved stretch).
